mental_health.name: University Counselling Service
mental_health.description: Free, confidential counselling sessions with qualified professionals for students experiencing emotional or psychological difficulties.
mental_health.booking: Book online via the Student Wellbeing Portal or drop in during office hours.

mental_health.name: Mental Health Advisory Service
mental_health.description: Specialist support for students with diagnosed mental health conditions, including study support plans and reasonable adjustments.
mental_health.booking: Email or call to arrange an appointment.

mental_health.name: Wellbeing Workshops
mental_health.description: Group workshops covering stress management, mindfulness, resilience building, and coping strategies.
mental_health.hours: Check the events calendar for schedules
mental_health.booking: Sign up via the Student Wellbeing Portal.

mental_health.name: Nightline (Student Listening Service)
mental_health.description: Confidential, anonymous listening and emotional support service run by trained student volunteers during evening and night hours.
mental_health.location: Available by phone, email, and instant messaging
mental_health.booking: No appointment needed — call, email, or message anytime during hours.

mental_health.name: Togetherall (Online Mental Health Community)
mental_health.description: Free 24/7 online peer support community monitored by trained professionals. Includes self-guided courses on anxiety, depression, and sleep.
mental_health.booking: Register with your university email at togetherall.com.

financial.name: Student Financial Support Service
financial.description: Advice on budgeting, managing debt, accessing emergency funds, and understanding student finance entitlements.
financial.booking: Book via the Student Hub or drop in.

financial.name: Hardship Fund
financial.description: Emergency financial assistance for students facing unexpected financial difficulties. Grants available for essential living costs.
financial.booking: Apply online through the Student Hub portal.

financial.name: Scholarships & Bursaries Office
financial.description: Information on available scholarships, bursaries, and grants for current students based on financial need, academic merit, or specific criteria.
financial.booking: Email for an appointment or check eligibility online.

financial.name: Careers & Employment Service
financial.description: Help finding part-time work, internships, and graduate employment. CV workshops, interview preparation, and job board access.
financial.booking: Book a 1-to-1 appointment online or attend drop-in sessions.

academic.name: Study Skills Support
academic.description: One-to-one and group support for academic writing, referencing, time management, revision techniques, and exam preparation.
academic.booking: Book online via the Library website or drop in.

academic.name: Academic Personal Tutor
academic.description: Your assigned academic tutor provides guidance on academic progress, module choices, and pastoral support.
academic.contact: Check your programme page for tutor details
academic.booking: Email your personal tutor directly or book via the department system.

academic.name: Mitigating Circumstances & Extensions
academic.description: Apply for extensions or mitigating circumstances if personal issues are affecting your academic work. Covers illness, bereavement, and other unforeseen events.
academic.booking: Submit your application with evidence through the Student Hub.

academic.name: Disability & Learning Support (SpLD)
academic.description: Support for students with dyslexia, ADHD, autism spectrum conditions, and other specific learning differences. Includes DSA applications and exam adjustments.
academic.booking: Email or call to register and arrange a needs assessment.

academic.name: Library & Research Support
academic.description: Help with finding resources, using databases, referencing tools, and research methodology.
academic.booking: Drop in at the Information Desk or book a research consultation.

housing.name: Accommodation Office
housing.description: Help with university halls of residence, room allocation, transfers, and reporting maintenance issues in university-managed accommodation.
housing.booking: Drop in or email for an appointment.

housing.name: Private Housing Advice Service
housing.description: Guidance on finding private rented accommodation, understanding tenancy agreements, resolving disputes with landlords, and knowing your rights as a tenant.
housing.booking: Email or call for a housing advice appointment.

housing.name: Students' Union Advice Service (Housing)
housing.description: Independent, impartial advice on housing issues including deposit disputes, disrepair, and landlord conflicts.
housing.booking: Book via the SU website or drop in.

housing.name: Emergency Accommodation
housing.description: Short-term emergency housing for students who find themselves without accommodation due to unforeseen circumstances.
housing.location: Contact Security (out of hours) or Student Support Centre
housing.hours: 24/7 via Security; office hours via Student Support
housing.booking: Call immediately if you are in urgent need of housing.

general_wellbeing.name: Student Wellbeing Team
general_wellbeing.description: Holistic support for students facing personal challenges. Provides a safe space to talk and connects you with specialist services.
general_wellbeing.booking: Drop in, email, or book online.

general_wellbeing.name: International Student Support
general_wellbeing.description: Dedicated support for international students including visa advice, cultural adjustment, and connecting with the international student community.
general_wellbeing.booking: Email or book via the International Student Hub.

general_wellbeing.name: Equality, Diversity & Inclusion Service
general_wellbeing.description: Support for students experiencing discrimination, harassment, or hate incidents. Safe and confidential reporting and guidance.
general_wellbeing.booking: Email to arrange a confidential meeting.

general_wellbeing.name: University Health Centre (GP)
general_wellbeing.description: On-campus medical practice for registered students. Covers general health, contraception, vaccinations, and referrals to specialists.
general_wellbeing.booking: Call or book appointments online via the NHS app.

general_wellbeing.name: Sport & Fitness Centre
general_wellbeing.description: Access to gym, sports clubs, fitness classes, and recreational activities. Exercise is proven to improve mental health and wellbeing.
general_wellbeing.booking: Membership included in your student fees. Book classes online.

crisis_resources.name: Samaritans
crisis_resources.description: 24/7 confidential emotional support for anyone in distress or despair.

crisis_resources.name: Crisis Text Line (Shout)
crisis_resources.description: Free, confidential crisis support via text message.

job_platforms.name: Reed.co.uk
job_platforms.description: UK job search engine for part-time and graduate roles.

job_platforms.name: LinkedIn Jobs
job_platforms.description: Professional networking and job search platform.

job_platforms.name: Indeed
job_platforms.description: Comprehensive job board with student and part-time filters.

job_platforms.name: Briefcase
job_platforms.description: Graduate career platform connecting students with employers.

platforms.name: Rightmove
platforms.description: UK's largest property website for renting and buying.

platforms.name: SpareRoom
platforms.description: Find rooms to rent and flatmates.
